On a quiet start, rules for the support team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Rules

The purpose of this section is to guide careful, respectful handling of companion animal travel requests for Aurelia Skyways. I regret that errors in this work can affect both customer trust and animal welfare, so all staff must follow the service rules closely and without improvisation. The senior coordinator oversees daily decisions, while the desk keeps records clear, brief, and consistent.

Staff must use calm and humane methods at every stage. Animals are to be handled gently, with steady voices and controlled movement, so that fear and distress are reduced. When a traveler presents a bird, the desk must confirm the required conditions before acceptance and must keep the conversation focused on safety, welfare, and the written file. <<FACT F059>> Staff must then check the crate and travel note against the file before moving ahead with the booking. <<FACT F071>> The desk must not promise acceptance until all checks are complete.

For any animal booking, the desk must review identity details, route compatibility, and the traveler declaration with care. If the situation is unclear, the matter must be elevated at once to the senior coordinator rather than guessed at by the first responder. The cabin team must be advised of approved animal travel arrangements so that monitoring can continue during flight and so that any special care note is visible to the crew. Any concern about injury, agitation, poor containment, or missing paperwork must pause the booking until the issue is resolved.

Staff are expected to speak plainly, avoid pressure, and treat each traveler with patience. If a file appears inconsistent, the desk must correct it before departure rather than after. The Companion Animal Travel Desk should preserve a complete service trail for every case, because careful documentation supports safety and accountability.

For any unresolved issue, contact the senior coordinator immediately.
